skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
The outfit this Operator wears most often.
While not as practical as a uniform, it's what they find most comfortable.

skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
An outfit that has been improved after the Operator's Promotion.
Custom-made to suit each Operator's experiences and needs, these outfits are designed to provide them maximum flexibility on any battlefield. Furthermore, this is all done without compromising the comfort that they've come to expect.

skins.name: An Airy Dream
skins.content: Test Collection Series/An Airy Dream. Rosmontis's lavender dream. In this dream, soft flowers bloom deep in her memories, and Rosmontis's skirt billows with the wind, leaping towards a light future with her companions.
skins.quote: In her dream, Rosmontis struggled to recall how to play this game of chess, but she knew that no matter where her path led, the pieces around her would accompany her.

skins.name: Become Anew
skins.content: EPOQUE Sub-Brand [Passe] Series Selects/Become Anew. Rosmontis's attire while still a test subject, adorned only by detectors and inhibitors.
skins.usage: One of Rosmontis's past lab outfits.
skins.quote: Rosmontis longs to know what it was that all those machines held back in concert. She's seen it. She's forgotten it.
